note: An installed hook whose local copy is deliberately different from the repository source. The repository stays the version everyone gets; a machine may run a changed copy for a stated reason and for a stated span. Each entry pins the fingerprint of the installed file it covers, so the moment that file changes again the entry stops matching and the health check reds. An entry buys silence for exactly the copy it names.
